leads.name: Kamani, Lahainaluna High School
leads.reason: School grounds (hard rule 10): Lahainaluna High School is a working public boarding school, not open to casual visitors. The campus does host Hale Pa'i, a public museum run by the Lahaina Restoration Foundation, which suggests some part of the grounds may be genuinely open, but I found no specific evidence the Kamani tree's location is on the open/museum side rather than the working campus. School itself confirmed NOT destroyed by the 2023 fire (its football team appeared in the Super Bowl LVIII coin toss ceremony afterward, per Wikipedia). Needs a pass that can confirm exactly where on campus this tree stands relative to Hale Pa'i's public access.

leads.name: West Indian Locust, Wailuku Sugar Plantation Manager's Home
leads.reason: Owner listed as 'Kaanapali Kai, Inc.' (a private company), accessibility field is an uncertain 'N/A?'. Could not confirm whether the grounds are open to the public in the time available; also could not confirm this building's actual town (the name says Wailuku but the register groups it with Kaanapali-area entries). Needs a pass to identify the actual property and its access terms.

leads.name: Monkeypod, Wailuku Sugar Plantation Manager's Home
leads.reason: Same site and same access uncertainty as register row 990 above; vitality recorded as only 'Fair' in the register, worth re-checking is-alive status too.

leads.name: Kamani, Old Hana School
leads.reason: Owner is State of Hawaii leased to County of Maui, which suggests a community facility rather than an active school, but I could not confirm what 'Old Hana School' is today (community center, museum, or still school grounds) or its public access terms in the time available. Web search tools were unreliable during this pass (see report).

leads.name: Breadfruit, Baldwin House
leads.reason: The Baldwin Home Museum itself was confirmed destroyed in the 8 August 2023 Lahaina wildfire (English Wikipedia, 'Dwight Baldwin (missionary)': 'On August 8, 2023, a massive wildfire destroyed the Baldwin Home Museum alongside most of the historic town of Lahaina'). No source found either way on whether this specific tree survived. Not moved to blocked because it is not confirmed dead, only unconfirmed; needs a post-2023 source (news, Lahaina Restoration Foundation update, satellite/aerial imagery) before it can ship either way.

leads.name: Kou, Baldwin House
leads.reason: Same site and same unconfirmed post-fire status as register row 993 above.

leads.name: Mexican Fan Palm, Hale Pa'ahao
leads.reason: Hale Pa'ahao (the old Lahaina prison) sits inside the Lahaina Historic District, within the area the 2023 wildfire devastated. No post-August-2023 source found confirming whether the site's trees survived; the Old Lahaina Courthouse a few blocks away was destroyed but the banyan park itself was untouched by the fire path, so the outcome for this site is genuinely unclear rather than assumed dead. Needs a dedicated check of Lahaina Restoration Foundation or news coverage of Hale Pa'ahao specifically.

leads.name: 'ohe #1, D.T. Fleming Arboretum at Pu'u Mahoe
leads.reason: D.T. Fleming Arboretum at Pu'u Mahoe, Kanaio, is registered to a private individual (Martha Vockrodt-Moran) and is a rare-Hawaiian-plant conservation collection in a remote part of southeast Maui. Could not confirm free public access, appointment-only access, or no access at all in the time available (general web search tools were rate-limited/bot-blocked during this pass). Girth/circumference figures for this row also conflict in the register itself and need re-checking against the physical tree. If access turns out to be appointment-only, this whole cluster of six stays blocked per hard rule 10.

leads.name: Redwood stands, Polipoli Spring State Recreation Area
leads.reason: 2026-11-03 verify pass: a stand (wood), not one place to stand; no per-tree measurement or planting date found (Wikipedia: park reforested in the 1930s with coast redwood among others; DLNR Redwood Trail page: 1.7 mi through stands of redwood and conifers, ends at old CCC camp). Polipoli is CLOSED as of 2026-10-01 because the surrounding Kula/Makawao/Waihou forest reserves are closed after Hurricane Nolo (mauinow.com 2026-10-01), no reopening date. Revisit if a single named redwood with a measurement turns up and the area reopens.

leads.name: Rainbow eucalyptus, Ke'anae Arboretum
leads.reason: 2026-11-03: state arboretum (Koolau Forest Reserve, DOFAW), 6 acres, 0.6 mi paved walk, est. 1971, labelled trees, about half a mile past mile marker 16 Hana Highway (20.8546,-156.1502 Nominatim). Free entry and hours not stated on any page fetched (one aggregator says daily 6am to 6pm, unverified). Closed Oct 28 to Dec 1 2024 for roadwork; no reopening notice found. A walk-through garden, no individual tree measured, no register row: not a collectible point yet. Needs a source naming one grove or tree and a reopening confirmation.

leads.name: Breadfruit collection and Pi'ilanihale, Kahanu Garden (NTBG)
leads.reason: 2026-11-03: paid garden at 650 Ulaino Rd, Hana (20.79917,-156.03833 per Wikipedia); world's largest breadfruit collection (about 150 varieties, est. 1970s). No individual tree size or age in any fetched source; admission figures conflict ($10 vs $18), NTBG page gives no price or hours, reservations encouraged. A collection, not a tree. Lead only until a named specimen with a measurement is found.

leads.name: Rainbow eucalyptus, Garden of Eden Arboretum
leads.reason: 2026-11-03: paid private garden at 10600 Hana Hwy, Haiku (about mile 10.5; 20.869,-156.180 Nominatim), roughly $20 adults per search summaries (not seen on an official page; official site not fetched). Rainbow eucalyptus is a highlight but no single tree, size or age sourced. Lead only.

leads.name: Baldwin House breadfruit 'Puloa' (ulu), Lahaina
leads.reason: 2026-11-03: stays held. Search summaries conflict on whether the trunk and canopy survived the Aug 2023 fire (one says coal-black trunk, one says trunk and canopy did not survive, roots may be alive); the County Arborist Committee had a Baldwin House breadfruit and kou nomination on a Nov 12, 2025 agenda (via search summary; mauicounty.gov 403). No dated source shows it standing and the site open.

leads.name: Old Hana School kamani (register M27, id 1120)
leads.reason: 2026-11-03: stays held. Still no source says what Old Hana School is used for or whether the grounds are open; a county bid 'Old Hana School Improvements' (P19/003) exists. County 2025 list says over 90 years old (search summary only). Needs a call or a Maui County Parks page; mauicounty.gov 403.
